question: How many orders have a status of completed?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed';

question: Which products are priced above 150 and below 300 euros?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT product_name, price FROM products WHERE price > 150 AND price < 300;

question: Which employees were hired in 2023?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name, hire_date FROM employees WHERE YEAR(hire_date) = 2023;

question: What are the 5 most expensive products?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT product_name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Which inventory records have fewer than 50 units in stock?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT inventory_id, product_id, warehouse_id, quantity FROM inventory WHERE quantity < 50;

question: How many categories are there in total?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM categories;

question: Which product has the lowest price?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT product_name, price FROM products ORDER BY price ASC LIMIT 1;

question: Which employees do not have a manager?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name FROM employees WHERE manager_id IS NULL;

question: Which customers are from Hamburg?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT first_name, last_name, city FROM customers WHERE city = 'Hamburg';

question: Which departments are located in Berlin?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT department_name, location FROM departments WHERE location = 'Berlin';

question: Which products are in the Laptops category?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT p.product_name, c.category_name FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.category_name = 'Laptops';

question: Which customers have placed orders?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.first_name, c.last_name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id;

question: Which employees work in the Sales department?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, d.department_name FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id WHERE d.department_name = 'Sales';

question: Which orders were handled by Julia Becker?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, o.status FROM orders o JOIN employees e ON o.handled_by = e.employee_id WHERE e.first_name = 'Julia' AND e.last_name = 'Becker';

question: What stock quantities are held in the Munich Regional Warehouse?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT i.product_id, i.quantity FROM inventory i JOIN warehouses w ON i.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id WHERE w.warehouse_name = 'Munich Regional Warehouse';

question: Which product lines had a quantity greater than 2?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT p.product_name, oi.quantity FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE oi.quantity > 2;

question: Which products have a stock record below 30 units?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT p.product_name, i.quantity FROM inventory i JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id WHERE i.quantity < 30;

question: Which orders were placed by customers based in Munich?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT o.order_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, o.order_date FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.city = 'Munich';

question: What are the line items for all cancelled orders?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT o.order_id, oi.product_id, oi.quantity, oi.unit_price FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'cancelled';

question: Which products belong to the Audio category?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT p.product_name, c.category_name FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.category_name = 'Audio';

question: Which employees work in the Fulfillment department?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, d.department_name FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id WHERE d.department_name = 'Fulfillment';

question: Which completed orders were placed by customers in Germany?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT o.order_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, o.status FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.country = 'Germany' AND o.status = 'completed';

question: Which inventory records in the Hamburg Fulfillment Center hold more than 100 units?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT i.product_id, i.quantity FROM inventory i JOIN warehouses w ON i.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id WHERE w.warehouse_name = 'Hamburg Fulfillment Center' AND i.quantity > 100;

question: Which products were sold at a unit price above 500 euros?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.product_name, oi.unit_price FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE oi.unit_price > 500;

question: Which products are in the Fitness Equipment category?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT p.product_name, c.category_name FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.category_name = 'Fitness Equipment';

question: How many employees are in each department?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT d.department_name, COUNT(e.employee_id) AS employee_count FROM departments d LEFT JOIN employees e ON d.department_id = e.department_id GROUP BY d.department_name ORDER BY employee_count DESC;

question: What are the top 5 products by total units sold?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_sold FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY total_sold DESC LIMIT 5;

question: How many orders were placed in each year?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT YEAR(order_date) AS order_year, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY YEAR(order_date) ORDER BY order_year;

question: How many distinct customers have ordered laptops?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS laptop_customers FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.category_name = 'Laptops';

question: What is the total revenue per product category?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.category_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.category_name ORDER BY revenue DESC;

question: How many orders has each customer placed?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY order_count DESC;

question: How many orders has each employee handled?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS orders_handled FROM employees e JOIN orders o ON o.handled_by = e.employee_id GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name ORDER BY orders_handled DESC;

question: What is the total stock held in each warehouse?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT w.warehouse_name, SUM(i.quantity) AS total_stock FROM warehouses w JOIN inventory i ON w.warehouse_id = i.warehouse_id GROUP BY w.warehouse_name ORDER BY total_stock DESC;

question: What is the average product price per category?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.category_name, AVG(p.price) AS avg_price FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.category_name ORDER BY avg_price DESC;

question: How many products are in each category, including empty categories?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.category_name, COUNT(p.product_id) AS product_count FROM categories c LEFT JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.category_name ORDER BY product_count DESC;

question: Which customers have placed more than 3 orders?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name HAVING COUNT(o.order_id) > 3 ORDER BY order_count DESC;

question: Which categories have total revenue above 5000 euros?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.category_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.category_name HAVING SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) > 5000 ORDER BY revenue DESC;

question: How many orders are there of each status?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY order_count DESC;

question: What are the top 5 products by total units in stock?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(i.quantity) AS total_units FROM products p JOIN inventory i ON p.product_id = i.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY total_units DESC LIMIT 5;

question: What is the average sold unit price per category?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.category_name, AVG(oi.unit_price) AS avg_sold_price FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.category_name ORDER BY avg_sold_price DESC;

question: Which employee handled the highest total sales value of Smartphones?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS smartphone_sales FROM employees e JOIN orders o ON e.employee_id = o.handled_by JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.category_name = 'Smartphones' GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name ORDER BY smartphone_sales DESC;

question: Which customers have spent more than the average customer?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name HAVING total_spent > (SELECT AVG(cust_total) FROM (SELECT SUM(oi2.quantity * oi2.unit_price) AS cust_total FROM orders o2 JOIN order_items oi2 ON o2.order_id = oi2.order_id GROUP BY o2.customer_id) AS averages);

question: Which products are priced above the overall average price?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT product_name, price FROM products WHERE price > (SELECT AVG(price) FROM products) ORDER BY price DESC;

question: Rank all products by price, highest first.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT product_name, price, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY price DESC) AS price_rank FROM products;

question: Which products have never been ordered?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT product_name FROM products WHERE product_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT product_id FROM order_items);

question: What is the most expensive product in each category?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT p.product_name, p.price, c.category_name FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE p.price = (SELECT MAX(p2.price) FROM products p2 WHERE p2.category_id = p.category_id);

question: Rank customers by total spend.
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_spent, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) DESC) AS spend_rank FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name;

question: Which orders have a value greater than the average order value?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS order_value FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id HAVING order_value > (SELECT AVG(order_total) FROM (SELECT SUM(oi2.quantity * oi2.unit_price) AS order_total FROM order_items oi2 GROUP BY oi2.order_id) AS order_avgs) ORDER BY order_value DESC;

question: Which customers ordered laptops that are stocked in the Berlin warehouse?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.first_name, c.last_name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories cat ON p.category_id = cat.category_id JOIN inventory i ON p.product_id = i.product_id JOIN warehouses w ON i.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id WHERE cat.category_name = 'Laptops' AND w.warehouse_name = 'Berlin Distribution Center';

question: Who is the top-spending customer, and what did they buy and at what price?
expected_columns: first_name, last_name, product_name, quantity, unit_price, line_total
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, p.product_name, oi.quantity, oi.unit_price, (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS line_total FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE c.customer_id = (SELECT o2.customer_id FROM orders o2 JOIN order_items oi2 ON o2.order_id = oi2.order_id GROUP BY o2.customer_id ORDER BY SUM(oi2.quantity * oi2.unit_price) DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY line_total DESC;
